title: [AUG-18] Improve empty state with illustration and onboarding guidance
why_we_need_this: When no sessions exist, the sidebar shows one line of gray text. First-time users see a dark sidebar with minimal guidance and a blank main area. Poor first impression for a manager productivity tool.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Empty sidebar state includes an SVG icon/illustration (microphone, waveform, or similar)
- [ ] A headline like "Record or upload your first meeting" replaces the plain text
- [ ] 2-3 step bullets show the workflow (upload/record → transcribe → review)
- [ ] Visual direction guides attention toward the upload area in main content
- [ ] Empty state uses existing design tokens and works in both light and dark themes
